7:## General Strategy
8:
9:- Always select "yes" to accept side missions when offered the choice to do so.
10:- Once Merlinus has joined your party, you will be prompted at the beginning of every single chapter whether or not you want to deploy him. Always select yes.
11:
12:## Recruiting Units
13:
14:In each chapter, there are often units that appear as green units (uncontrollable allies) or red units (enemies). These units can often be recruited by executing the Talk action with a specific player-controlled unit, but there are some more complex conditions that have to be fulfilled in order to recruit some characters. For each chapter, you have been provided a list of the recruitable units that appear and the conditions that need to be fulfilled in order to recruit the character. You should try to recruit units if possible, but it is not a strict requirement.
15:
16:The chapter sections below cover Lyn mode and Hector mode. Eliwood mode is not covered. Recruits are the same on normal and hard difficulty throughout the entire game, so use the list for your mode regardless of difficulty.
17:
18:## Broad strategy notes
19:
20:Cross-chapter lessons the agent adds as it plays. Append below.
21:
22:- Player-initiated attacks end the turn adjacent to the target, so the enemy swings AGAIN on its phase: count both exchanges before attacking a boss. Waiting adjacent at full HP (they swing first) is often safer. (s01)
23:- Restart Chapter's "Suspended data will be lost" box: wait for the text, press Left, then A. RNG appears to repeat on restart for identical inputs. (s01)
